Dear Lean Community,

We're building a platform, i2forge, to reduce barriers of entry in formal verification. We want to make a special-purpose tool that is designed for mathematicians rather than something built for programmers (such as GitHub).

We began by integrating our (early-stages, experimental) language i2 and now want to integrate Lean.

We would like to invite experienced users of Lean to work with us on this, so we can understand the pain points you encounter and focus on these. We want to understand the things (not related to Lean per se) but development environments, difficulties setting up, collaborating, etc. that are most burdensome, so that the tools we build will be useful.

Participation would involve a brief online call (30–60 minutes) initially, and then after we have done an iteration we would follow up again and listen to your feedback on the same. Alternatively, if you are more comfortable interacting in written form, we would also consider this. (As a token of appreciation, when the platform is ready we will issue credits to your account.)

If you are open to working with us on this, please email Amisi (a@iforge.com) or Claude (b@i2forge.com) or DM.

Full disclosure: We view this is a commercial venture.

Thank you for your time,
Amisi and Claude.
